A technology partner that started here, and was built to serve here first.

Hive Information Technology was founded in Windhoek in 2020 to close a gap we kept running into: Namibian businesses were being sold IT solutions designed for someone else's market, at someone else's prices. We set out to build the local alternative.

Today we work across logistics, trading, dental, transport and professional services, pairing software and web development with cybersecurity, data analytics and ICT supply — so a client can come to one team for the system, the site, and the security around both.

Every engagement is handled by our own staff, priced for the Namibian market, and backed by a support desk that's reachable around the clock.

Client training

Software is only useful once your team can run it without us.

Alongside every build, Hive trains the people who will actually use it — front-desk staff, finance teams, IT administrators — so a new system or process sticks long after our developers move on to the next project.

How it works

A short, practical curriculum — not a manual

We build every training session around your actual system and your actual staff, not a generic slide deck.

  • 01

    Scope the need

    We sit with your team to see who uses the system, how, and where they currently get stuck.

  • 02

    Build the curriculum

    Materials are written around your workflows and screens, in plain language, not vendor documentation.

  • 03

    Run the sessions

    Delivered on-site in Windhoek or remotely, in small groups so everyone gets hands-on time.

  • 04

    Support & refresh

    Follow-up sessions and our 24/7 desk catch the questions that only come up after go-live.
